title: 第11章【冥婚】方东的尸体
slug: 诡异副本勇敢者的游戏
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

听到顾原的声音，方东将自己手中的工具递给他，儿顾原以为一切都很简单，只要找到方东的尸体就可以了，可令他没想到的是，当他接过工具的一瞬间，周围竟然开始发生了翻天覆地的变化。

原本还明亮的天空就在自己接过工具的一瞬间，天就黑了下来，伸手不见五指的黑，周围只有星星点点的亮光。

紧接着，顾原抬头看着天空，却发现头顶一片漆黑，不是正常的黑。

片刻后，他终于反应过来，自己似乎是进入到了另外一种空间，而那些发光的东西，竟然就是身边的杏树。

除此之外，他还可以看到身边大大小小方东挖出来的深坑。

他的时间有限，只能动手。

顾原握紧那把锈迹斑斑的铁锹，站在黑暗的环境中，借着那些杏树发出来的微弱光芒开始寻找方东的尸体。

铁锹下去，泥土松软的不像话，就像是一摊淤泥一样，散发着腥臭的味道。

可是，第一个坑挖了半天，缺什么都没有挖到。

果然，这个任务并不是这么简单就能完成的，否则方东也不会在这里挖出这么多的坑。

但是方东的任务到底是什么，难道只是寻找到自己的尸体这么简单，不可能，剧本杀中的所有任务几乎是全部相关的，不可能出现这么一个单独的突兀的任务。

只不过自己现在没有太多的时间去思考。

从第一个深坑离开之后，顾原开始了第二次的挖坑，身旁的阴风吹过，带着腥臭和腐烂的味道，熏的顾原干呕起来，差点吐了出来。

很快，第二个坑已经被挖了一米多深，但依旧什么东西都没有出现，顾原几乎要放弃，重新找个地方挖坑的时候，一铁锹下去，却似乎是撞到了什么。

顾原蹲下来，用手扒开泥土，紧接着就摸到了那东西，是一只手。

一只青黑色的手，奇怪的是这只手并没有腐烂，而是除了颜色变化之外，竟然和正常人的手一样，只不过摸起来冰冷的瘆人。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Hearing Gu Yuan's voice, Fang Dong handed him the tool in his hand. Gu thought everything was simple, as long as he found Fang Dong's body. But what he didn't expect was that the moment he took the tool, the surroundings began to undergo earth-shaking changes.

The originally bright sky turned dark the moment he took over the tool. It was so dark that he couldn't see his fingers, and there were only dots of bright light around him.

Immediately afterwards, Gu Yuan looked up at the sky, only to find that the top of his head was pitch black, not normal black.

After a moment, he finally realized that he seemed to have entered another kind of space, and the glowing things turned out to be the apricot trees next to him.

In addition, he could also see the deep pits dug by Fang Dong, large and small, around him.

His time is limited and he can only do it.

Gu Yuan clenched the rusty shovel, stood in the dark environment, and started looking for Fang Dong's body with the faint light from the almond trees.

When the shovel was removed, the soil was incredibly soft, like a pool of mud, exuding a fishy smell.

However, after digging the first hole for a long time, nothing was found.

Sure enough, this task is not so simple to complete, otherwise Fang Dong would not have dug so many holes here.

But what exactly is Fang Dong's mission? Is it as simple as finding his own body? It's impossible. Almost all the missions in the script are related. It's impossible for such a single and sudden mission to appear.

It's just that I don't have much time to think now.

After leaving the first deep pit, Gu Yuan started digging the second pit. The dark wind blew by him, carrying a fishy and rotten smell, which made Gu Yuan retching and almost vomited.

Soon, the second hole was dug more than one meter deep, but nothing appeared. Gu Yuan almost gave up. When he was looking for a new place to dig a hole, when he went down with the shovel, he seemed to hit something.

Gu Yuan knelt down and dug away the dirt with his hands, and then he touched the thing, which was a hand.

A blue-black hand. The strange thing is that this hand is not rotten, but other than the color change, it is the same as a normal person's hand, but it feels cold and cold to the touch.
